resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and French source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded French pass identified 25 actionable defects in battery summaries, evidence notes, and safety wording; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent French human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The removable-cell summary was awkwardly phrased.
evidence: The previous wording added an unnecessary literal construction for a rechargeable cell.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a concise description of a removable rechargeable cell for compatible devices.

findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary did not clearly distinguish an internal pack from a replaceable cell.
evidence: The previous wording described an internal battery without clearly stating that it is integrated.
findings.resolution: Added the integrated-pack and user-replaceable-cell distinction.

findings.summary: The approval note used the wrong gender agreement for the implied record.
evidence: The previous text began with feminine ‘Approuvée’ although the implied record is masculine.
findings.resolution: Changed the agreement to ‘Approuvé’.

findings.summary: The capacity note used less precise label language.
evidence: The previous wording said the label suggested a value rather than identifying the labeled capacity.
findings.resolution: Changed it to state that true capacity is below the capacity shown on the label.

findings.summary: The continuous-rating note was not grammatical French.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Une cote continue’ and an incorrect literal term for pulse ratings.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as 20 A continuous current and explicitly excluded pulse values.

findings.summary: The comparison note had malformed number placement.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Une valeur’ and awkwardly arranged the wrapper and production qualifiers.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent independent 20 A comparison value.

findings.summary: The exact-model testing note had malformed number placement and unnatural phrasing.
evidence: The previous text used ‘15 Une valeur’ and awkwardly described the CCC-marked revision.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 15 A value from testing the exact model.

findings.summary: The tabless-revision note mistranslated the tested-cell description.
evidence: The previous wording referred to the tested tabless revision as a revision of ‘tables’.
findings.resolution: Used the technical term ‘tabless’ and retained the warning against substituting pulse values.

findings.summary: The true-continuous-value note was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘36 Une vraie valeur continue’ rather than a natural technical phrase.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a true 36 A continuous value with the 56 A figure temperature-limited.

findings.summary: The pre-production and CCC caveat used awkward literal wording.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Une valeur’ and an unnatural construction for pre-production cells.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 40 A value for tested pre-production cells without the CCC logo.

findings.summary: The recommended continuous value note was malformed and unclear about cycle life.
evidence: The previous text used ‘13 Une valeur’ and a literal phrase for the cycle-life limitation.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a recommended 13 A continuous value and an absolute 16.8 A maximum.

findings.summary: The 70 A temperature caveat was awkwardly translated.
evidence: The previous text used a literal ‘limité en température’ fragment and malformed value placement.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 40 A value with temperature-limited 70 A and pre-production samples.

findings.summary: The production-cell comparison note was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Une valeur’ and did not naturally present the 70 A control requirement.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 40 A production-cell comparison value requiring temperature control at 70 A.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper note used a literal translation of rewrap and malformed value placement.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Une valeur’ and left the technical term ‘rewrap’ unexplained.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 40 A exact-wrapper value limited to 60 °C and tested as an EVE 40PL rewrap.

findings.summary: The 19 A evidence note had malformed number placement.
evidence: The previous text used ‘19 Une valeur’ and awkwardly described exact tested samples.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 19 A value for pre-production samples without CCC marks.

findings.summary: The 40 A and 90 A caveat used unnatural temperature wording.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Une valeur’ and the literal fragment ‘limité en température’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 40 A value with temperature-limited 90 A.

findings.summary: The production-continuity caveat was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Une valeur’ and a literal construction for unresolved production continuity.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 40 A value with temperature-limited 60 A and unresolved production continuity.

findings.summary: The capacity and marking caveat used awkward phrasing.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Une valeur’ and an unnatural term for inconsistent capacity.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 40 A value for samples with irregular capacity and missing marks.

findings.summary: The 13 A evidence note had malformed number placement.
evidence: The previous text used ‘13 Une valeur’ and an unnatural sentence structure.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a prudent 13 A value for pre-production samples without CCC marks.

findings.summary: The tester estimate note was malformed.
evidence: The previous text began with ‘30 A valeur’ and used a literal temperature phrase.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a tester-estimated 30 A continuous value with Reliance's 50 A maximum temperature-limited.

findings.summary: The two-batch production note had malformed number placement.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Une valeur’ and a literal construction for temperature limitation.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 20 A continuous value from two tested production-related batches.

findings.summary: The continuous-versus-pulse distinction used awkward technical French.
evidence: The previous wording was understandable but used an unnatural phrase for pulse-only current.
findings.resolution: Clarified 12 A continuous, 20 A pulse-only, and preserved the exact wrapper identifier.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper and sourcing caveat contained malformed number placement and literal terms.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Une valeur’ and mixed French, English, and literal wrapper terminology.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the 20 A value, tester recommendation, advertisement, and sourcing caveat.

findings.summary: The rewrap note was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘30 Une valeur’ and an awkward construction for later wrapper revisions.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 30 A exact-model value and identified it as a rewrap.

findings.summary: The revision-specific inheritance warning was awkwardly translated.
evidence: The previous text used ‘30 Une valeur’ and an unnatural literal description of the leg revisions.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the exact five-leg revision value and warning against inheriting the profile.
